title: Report: Air Force Research Regarding the "Roswell Incident", July 1, 1994
doc_notes: This document is a 1994 Air Force report detailing the internal research and investigation into the 1947 Roswell incident, concluding it was a Project Mogul balloon.

incidents.summary: Recovery of debris from a crashed object near Roswell, New Mexico, initially reported as a flying disc and later identified by the military as a weather balloon/radar target.
incidents.explanation: Debris from a Project Mogul balloon train, specifically a service flight.
incidents.quote: The object turned out to be a radar tracking balloon
incidents.size: 12 feet long balloon, debris scattered over 200 yards

incidents.summary: A Roswell couple claimed to have seen a large unidentified object fly by their home.
incidents.quote: a Roswell couple claimed to have seen a large unidentified object fly by their home

incidents.summary: Report of a flying disc incident involving Ellington Field, Texas and the Spokane Depot, later determined to be a hoax.
incidents.quote: this particular incident involved Ellington Field, Texas and the Spokane (Washington) Depot. After much discussion... it was learned to be a hoax.
